sql:
SELECT 
    P.Policy_Number,
    COUNT(*) AS Number_of_Claims,
    AVG(LP.Claim_Amount) AS Average_Loss
FROM Policy_Payment LP
JOIN Policy_Payment LP2 ON LP.Claim_Amount_Identifier = LP2.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy P ON LP.Claim_Amount_Identifier = P.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY P.Policy_Number
ORDER BY P.Policy_Number

    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN lp.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN lr.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ep.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN er.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN p.Premium IS NOT NULL THEN p.Premium ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Ratio

    AVG(Loss_Reserve.Claim_Amount_Identifier) AS Avg_Loss_Reserve,
    AVG(Expense_Payment.Claim_Amount_Identifier) AS Avg_Expense_Payment,
    AVG(Expense_Reserve.Claim_Amount_Identifier) AS Avg_Expense_Reserve
FROM
    Policy
JOIN
    Claim_Coverage ON Policy.Policy_Identifier = Claim_Coverage.Policy_Identifier
JOIN
    Claim_Amount ON Claim_Coverage.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = Claim_Amount.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN
    Loss_Payment ON Loss_Payment.Claim_Amount_Identifier = Claim_Amount.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN
    Loss_Reserve ON Loss_Reserve.Claim_Amount_Identifier = Claim_Amount.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN
    Expense_Payment ON Expense_Payment.Claim_Amount_Identifier = Claim_Amount.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN
    Expense_Reserve ON Expense_Reserve.Claim_Amount_Identifier = Claim_Amount.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE
    Policy.Policy_Number IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    Policy.Policy_Number;

    CL.Claim_Identifier AS ClaimNumber,
    PL.Policy_Number AS PolicyNumber,
    P.Policy_Identifier AS PolicyHolder,
    PA.Policy_Amount AS PremiumAmount,
    CL.Claim_Amount AS LossPayment,
    LR.Claim_Amount AS LossReserve,
    EP.Claim_Amount AS ExpensePayment,
    ER.Claim_Amount AS ExpenseReserve,
    CL.Catastrophe_Identifier AS Catastrophe,
    P.Agreement_Identifier AS Agent
FROM 
    Claim CL
JOIN 
    Policy_Amount PA ON CL.Claim_Identifier = PA.Claim_Identifier
JOIN 
    Policy P ON PA.Policy_Identifier = P.Policy_Identifier
JOIN 
    Claim_Coverage CC ON CL.Claim_Identifier = CC.Claim_Identifier
JOIN 
    Catastrophe C ON CL.Catastrophe_Identifier = C.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN 
    Premium PAJ ON PA.Policy_Amount_Identifier = PAJ.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN 
    Agreement_Party_Role APR ON P.Agreement_Identifier = APR.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN 
    Loss_Payment LP ON CL.Claim_Identifier = LP.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN 
    Loss_Reserve LR ON CL.Claim_Identifier = LR.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN 
    Expense_Payment EP ON CL.Claim_Identifier = EP.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN 
    Expense_Reserve ER ON CL.Claim_Identifier = ER.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE 
    CL.Claim_Status_Code = 'Open' AND CL.Claim_Reported_Date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day';

SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Number_of_Claims,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN lp.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Loss_Payment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN lr.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Loss_Reserve,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ep.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Expense_Payment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN er.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Expense_Reserve,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN lp.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN lr.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ep.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN er.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Loss,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN lp.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN lr.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ep.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN er.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN p.Premium IS NOT NULL THEN p.Premium ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON p.Policy_Identifier = cc.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim c ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON cc.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON cc.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON cc.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON cc.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE p.Policy_Number IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number

    p.Policy_Number,
    a.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Amount,
    SUM(lp.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss_payments,
    SUM(lr.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss_reserves,
    SUM(ep.Claim_Amount) AS total_expense_payments,
    SUM(er.Claim_Amount) AS total_expense_reserves
FROM Claim c

JOIN Policy p ON ca.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, p.Policy_Number, a.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Amount

    pol.Policy_Number AS Policy_Number,
    par.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder,
    pre.Policy_Amount AS Premium_Amount,
    agt.Party_Identifier AS Agent

    Claim clm

    Claim_Amount cla ON clm.Claim_Identifier = cla.Claim_Identifier

    Loss_Payment lsp ON cla.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lsp.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    Loss_Reserve lrs ON cla.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lrs.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    Expense_Payment exp ON cla.Claim_Amount_Identifier = exp.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    Expense_Reserve ers ON cla.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ers.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    Policy pol ON cla.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier

    Agreement_Party_Role agp ON pol.Policy_Identifier = agp.Agreement_Identifier

    Party par ON agp.Party_Identifier = par.Party_Identifier
JOIN 
    Premium pre ON cla.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pre.Policy_Amount_Identifier

    Agreement_Party_Role agt ON pol.Policy_Identifier = agt.Agreement_Identifier

    c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number AS Policy_Number,
    agp.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder,
    SUM(lp.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss_Payment,
    SUM(lr.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss_Reserve,
    SUM(ep.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Expense_Payment,
    SUM(er.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Expense_Reserve,
    SUM(pr.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium_Paid
FROM Claim c
JOIN Policy p ON c.Insurable_Object_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role agp ON p.Policy_Identifier = agp.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Amount pr ON p.Policy_Identifier = pr.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY 
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    agp.Party_Identifier
